positions.commentary: The speaker states that Berkshire Hathaway has gone up 300 times from where they bought it and wishes they had bought more.

thesis: This episode presents a bullish thesis on Berkshire Hathaway, framing the stock as a successful defensive investment based on specific advice received. The speaker highlights the significant appreciation of the position since purchase and expresses regret over not acquiring a larger stake.

claims.claim: The speaker bought Berkshire Hathaway as a defensive move after being told by Sandy Goddustman that it was a safe and sane investment, and it has worked out beautifully.
claims.quote: He said, well, that's easy, Berkshire. I said, you mean Warren Buffett's outfit? He said, yeah, Berkshire Hathway. Well, tell me all about it. For the next 40 minutes, Sandy Goddustman, who was chairman of Berkshire Hathaway told me one after another, there's different factors that caused him to believe that one really was a superb investor.
